Highlights:
## GRAPHICS

C TECHNICAL SPECIFIA CATIONSRD LIVE TO GAS ME_ *Extended warranty exclusions may apply based on country/region. Product Registration is required within 30 days of purchase on zotac.com.

SPECIFICATIONS

• NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 GPU 
• 5888 CUDA cores 
• 8GB GDDR6 memory 
• 256-bit memory bus 
• Engine boost clock: 1725 MHz 
• Memory clock: 14.0 Gbps 
• PCI Express 4.0 16x 

DIMENSIONS

• Length: 231.9mm (9.1in) 
• Height: 141.3mm (5.6in) 
• Width: Dual slot (41.5mm) (1.6in) Box 
• Height: 363mm (14.3in) 
• Width: 261mm (10.3in) 
• Depth: 100mm (3.9in) 

INSIDE THE BOX

• ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 Twin Edge LHR 
• 2 x Dual 6-pin to 8-pin cable 
• User Manual 

POWER REQUIREMENTS

• 650-watt power supply recommended 
• 220-watt max power consumption 
• 2 x 8-pin power connector 

CONNECTIONS

• 3 x DisplayPort 1.4a (up to 7680x4320@60Hz) 
• 1 x HDMI 2.1 (up to 7680x4320@60Hz) 
• HDCP 2.3 support 
• Quad simultaneous display capable 

SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY

• Game Ready Drivers and NVIDIA Studio Drivers 
• Microsoft DirectX 12 Ultimate, Vulkan RT API 
• OpenGL 4.6 
• Windows 10 64-bit (build 2004 or later) 

FEATURES

• White LED Lighting 
• IceStorm 2.0 Advanced Cooling 
• Active Fan Control with FREEZE Fan Stop 
• Metal Wraparound Backplate 
• GDDR6 Graphics Memory 
• 2nd Gen Ray Tracing Cores 
• 3rd Gen Tensor Cores 
• VR Ready, NVIDIA DLSS 
• NVIDIA® GeForce Experience™ 
• NVIDIA G-SYNC® , NVIDIA GPU Boost™ 
• LHR 25 MH/s ETH hash rate (est.) 

EAN: 4895173623417 UPC: 810012082426

### GEFORCE RTX™ 3070 TWIN EDGE LHR

®

#### TWIN EDGE

2.0

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™

30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture.

Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, new streaming multiprocessors, and high-speed GDDR6 memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 Twin

Edge LHR gives rise to amplified gaming with high

fidelity.

##### SKU: ZT-A30700E-10PLHR
